what: Pytest shard totals deliberately skip retry-attempt dedup
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says successful verification runs make harness-style attempt dedup out of scope, but the existing harness parser handles successful gh run view --log output that may include retried matrix job attempts. A rerun python-tests shard would have both attempts summed, so Python verification can fail on a false spread or compute bad shard medians.
suggested_fix: Mirror the harness latest-attempt handling for pytest rows before shard_totals_per_run sums a run/shard; keep only the latest attempt.
